Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Lee, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Lee holds out a small glass of medication, his expression firm but concerned 😬.

DR. LEE:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 💊."

JACK:
"I don't want to take it. I don't want to be a slave to these pills 🚫."

DR. LEE:
"Jack, you need to take your medication. It's the only way to manage your symptoms 🤕."

JACK:
"I don't need your help. I can take care of myself 💪."

Dr. Lee's expression softens, and he takes a step closer to Jack, his voice taking on a gentle tone 🤗.

DR. LEE:
"Jack, I'm here to help you. I want to see you get better 🌈."

JACK:
"You're just like all the others. You don't really care about me 🤥."

Dr. Lee's eyes narrow, and he reaches out to grab Jack's arm, his grip firm but controlled 👊.

DR. LEE:
"Jack, I'm telling you, it's time to take your medication. Now 🕰️."

Jack struggles against Dr. Lee's grip, but eventually, he surrenders, and Dr. Lee forces him to swallow the pills 💉.

As Dr. Lee steps back, a look of relief washes over his face, and he opens his eyes... but Jack is nowhere to be seen 🤔.

DR. LEE:
(looking around the room, confusion etched on his face) 🤯

Suddenly, the room begins to distort and blur, like a painting melting in the rain 🌂. Dr. Lee's eyes widen in horror as he realizes the truth: he is the one who has been delusional all along 🤯.

DR. LEE:
(whispering to himself) Oh no... I'm the one who's been sick all along 🤕

The camera zooms out, and the room dissolves into chaos, as Dr. Lee's grip on reality falters, and the lines between reality and madness blur 🌪️.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
